summary: Verified the whileInView scroll-container regression fix on Dynamo Feed. All five left-column profile sections render with computed opacity=1 on initial load (no scrolling needed) and remain visible after scrolling the left column to its bottom. Collapsed-section previews, open/independent toggling, left-column order, skill chips, social-resume styling, absence of stats-strip and footer, and mobile portfolio sheet were all validated.

ui_bugs.issue: Visible placeholder text 'REPLACE: show 1', 'show · 2024' and 'REPLACE: one line on why' rendering in production — looks like unresolved template placeholders in now.json or card.

action_items: Replace the 'REPLACE: show 1' / 'REPLACE: one line on why' placeholder strings in the Watch-this card data (now.json or equivalent) with real content.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix verified: CollapsibleSection/SocialLinks/SkillChips rendering as plain visible elements works as intended; LeftColumn mount fade does not block visibility.

Note: at 1440x900 the left column's scrollHeight equals clientHeight (2690=2690), meaning the inner column is NOT actually scrolling — the page scrolls. Not a bug for this fix, but worth confirming the intended desktop UX if an inner-scroll container was planned.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verification details — Desktop 1440x900: profile-section-{experience,projects,writing,community,education} all opacity=1 pre-scroll and post-scroll. Previews: writing='IoTaaS... · Enhancing...' (2 items, no +N), community='GitHub Campus Expert · Azure mentor' (2 items), education='B.Tech... · Azure AI Fundamentals (AI-901) · +1' (3 items). Experience open with 4 items (profile-item-experience-0..3), Projects open with items 0..1 visible; opening writing did not collapse experience (independent toggles). Left-column testid order: profile-header → social-links (linkedin/github/email/resume) → skill-chips (7 chips) → five profile sections. stats-strip absent, no footer card. social-resume class matches other circles: 'grid size-11 place-items-center rounded-full bg-surface text-cream/80 shadow-soft transition hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:text-sage'. Mobile 390x844: opening topbar-profile-button opens portfolio sheet with sections at opacity=1 and previews shown. Only non-fix issue found: 'REPLACE:' placeholder strings visible in RightColumn 'Watch this' card.
rca of the issue: Original bug (sections invisible due to framer-motion whileInView never firing inside the left column's own scroll container) is fully resolved by the applied fix. Confirmed via computed opacity checks on all five sections with no scrolling priming.
